strings.maxbytes_desc: If set to zero will be unlimited by default
strings.privacy:metadata: The Text area field component doesn't store any personal data; it uses tables defined in mod_data.
strings.sample:
This is a text area. It lets users enter long form text which spans over multiple lines.

You can choose the size of your text areas in rows and columns.

The text in a text area can be formatted, for example in bold, and also include links or images.
